get_router_settings: get the router configuration including all configurable settings with current values and available routing strategies
get_router_fields: get router settings field definitions without values for UI rendering of configurable options
extract_routing_strategies: extract available routing strategies dynamically from the Router class __init__ method signature
build_router_settings_response: build a pydantic response model containing router settings fields, current values, and routing strategy descriptions
build_router_fields_response: build a pydantic response model containing router settings field metadata without populated values
